column1: # Recordings of native speakers Wingman clones as Pocket TTS voices (see
# providers/pocket_tts_voices.py). 8 to 13 seconds each, 24 kHz mono, cut at
# pauses from the source and picked by how well their clones speak German
# (UTMOS, Parakeet word error rate; 2026-09-24). Credited in README.md too.
